display.title: With Ten Sayings: Hashem Creates the World Every Moment
display.summary_short: A Sefirah talk on Pirkei Avos chapter 5: a carpenter only shapes wood, but Hashem creates something from nothing and keeps the world alive every second.
display.summary_long: A talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show during Sefirah, as Shavuos approaches. To prepare to receive the Torah, we improve our midos by learning Pirkei Avos, and this Shabbos children learn the fifth chapter, which opens: 'With ten sayings the world was created.' Uncle Yossi connects it to the first words of the Torah and 'Let there be light.' Creating means making something from nothing, which only Hashem can do. A carpenter builds a chair from wood that already exists, and the chair stays after he leaves. Hashem made the world from nothing, so He must keep creating it every second; if He stopped, it would return to nothing, just as a light bulb goes dark the moment the electric current stops. Knowing that our life comes from Hashem, we show our thanks by learning Torah, the Torah of life, doing mitzvos, and improving how we behave with parents, teachers and friends before Shavuos.
display.lesson: Hashem gives us life every moment; we thank Him with Torah, mitzvos and good midos.
